starters-game.definition: Something fun you play with rules.
starters-game.definitionVi: Trò chơi vui có luật chơi.
starters-game.hint: Board games and tag are both games.
starters-game.fact: Playing games helps you learn to take turns.

starters-garden.definition: An outdoor place where plants grow.
starters-garden.definitionVi: Khu vực ngoài trời để trồng cây.
starters-garden.hint: Flowers and vegetables can grow here.
starters-garden.fact: Bees love visiting gardens for nectar.

starters-get.definitionVi: Nhận hoặc lấy được cái gì đó.
starters-get.hint: You get a gift on your birthday.
starters-get.fact: People get mail from the post office.

starters-giraffe.definition: A tall African animal with a long neck.
starters-giraffe.definitionVi: Loài thú cao, cổ dài ở châu Phi.
starters-giraffe.hint: It eats leaves from tall trees.
starters-giraffe.fact: A giraffe's tongue can be 45 cm long.

starters-girl.hint: She might be your sister or friend.
starters-girl.fact: Every girl can learn and play anything.

starters-give.definitionVi: Đưa hoặc tặng cái gì cho ai.
starters-give.hint: You give a present to a friend.
starters-give.fact: Giving makes both people feel happy.

starters-glasses.definition: Clear lenses you wear to see better.
starters-glasses.definitionVi: Kính đeo để nhìn rõ hơn.
starters-glasses.hint: They sit on your nose and ears.
starters-glasses.fact: Some glasses protect eyes from the sun.

starters-go.definition: to move from one place to another.
starters-go.definitionVi: Đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác.
starters-go.hint: We go to school every morning.
starters-go.fact: People go by foot, bike, bus, or car.

starters-go-to-bed.definition: to lie down in bed to rest.
starters-go-to-bed.hint: You do this at night before sleep.
starters-go-to-bed.fact: A bedtime story helps many children relax.

starters-go-to-sleep.definition: to close your eyes and fall asleep.
starters-go-to-sleep.definitionVi: Nhắm mắt và chìm vào giấc ngủ.
starters-go-to-sleep.hint: You feel sleepy and close your eyes.
starters-go-to-sleep.fact: Most children need about ten hours of sleep.

starters-goat.definition: A farm animal with horns and a beard.
starters-goat.definitionVi: Con dê nuôi ở trang trại.
starters-goat.fact: Goats can climb steep rocks easily.

starters-good.definition: Nice, kind, or of high quality.

starters-grandfather.hint: He is your dad's or mum's dad.

starters-grandma.definitionVi: Cách gọi thân mật cho bà.
starters-grandma.hint: She might bake cookies for you.

starters-grandmother.hint: She is your dad's or mum's mum.
starters-grandmother.fact: Grandmothers love spending time with grandchildren.

starters-grandpa.definitionVi: Cách gọi thân mật cho ông.
starters-grandpa.hint: He might take you to the park.

starters-grape.definition: A small round sweet or sour fruit.
starters-grape.definitionVi: Quả nho nhỏ, ngọt hoặc chua.
starters-grape.hint: They grow in bunches on vines.
starters-grape.fact: Purple grapes can be dried to make raisins.

starters-gray.definition: The colour between black and white.
starters-gray.definitionVi: Màu xám, giữa đen và trắng.
starters-gray.hint: Clouds can look gray before rain.
starters-gray.fact: Elephants and dolphins are often gray.

starters-great.hint: You say "Great!" when something is wonderful.
starters-great.fact: The Great Wall of China is very long.

starters-green.definition: The colour of grass and leaves.
starters-green.hint: Grass and leaves are this colour.
starters-green.fact: Green plants make oxygen we breathe.

starters-grey.definition: The colour between black and white.
starters-grey.fact: A grey sky often means rain is coming.

starters-guitar.definition: A string instrument you strum or pluck.
starters-guitar.definitionVi: Nhạc cụ dây, gảy hoặc gõ.
starters-guitar.hint: It has six strings and a long neck.
starters-guitar.fact: Guitars can be acoustic or electric.

starters-hair.definition: The soft strands on your head.
starters-hair.fact: Hair grows a little bit every day.

starters-hall.definition: A long room or passage in a building.
starters-hall.definitionVi: Hành lang hoặc phòng dài trong nhà.
starters-hall.hint: You walk through it to reach rooms.
starters-hall.fact: School halls are where students line up.

starters-hand.definition: The part at the end of your arm.
starters-hand.definitionVi: Bàn tay ở cuối cánh tay.
starters-hand.hint: It has five fingers for holding things.
starters-hand.fact: Your hand has 27 small bones inside.

starters-handbag.definition: A small bag a woman carries.
starters-handbag.definitionVi: Túi xách nhỏ phụ nữ hay mang.
starters-handbag.hint: Mum might keep keys and phone inside.
starters-handbag.fact: Handbags come in many colours and sizes.

starters-happy.definitionVi: Cảm thấy vui và hạnh phúc.
starters-happy.hint: You feel happy on your birthday.
starters-happy.fact: Smiling can help you feel happier too.

starters-hat.definition: Something you wear on your head.
starters-hat.hint: It keeps sun or rain off your head.

starters-have.definitionVi: Có, sở hữu cái gì đó.
starters-have.fact: You can have friends, toys, or pets.

starters-have-got.definitionVi: Có cái gì (cách nói thông dụng).

starters-head.definition: The top part of your body.
starters-head.definitionVi: Phần trên cơ thể — cái đầu.
starters-head.hint: Your eyes, nose, and mouth are on it.
starters-head.fact: Your brain inside your head helps you think.

starters-helicopter.definition: A flying machine with spinning blades on top.
starters-helicopter.definitionVi: Máy bay có cánh quạt trên đầu.
starters-helicopter.hint: It can hover and land in small spaces.
starters-helicopter.fact: Helicopters can rescue people in mountains.

starters-hippo.definition: A huge African animal that loves water.
starters-hippo.definitionVi: Hà mã — thú lớn sống ở châu Phi.
starters-hippo.hint: It spends lots of time in rivers.
starters-hippo.fact: Hippos can hold their breath underwater.

starters-hobby.definition: Something fun you do in free time.
starters-hobby.fact: Hobbies help you learn new skills.

starters-hockey.definition: A team sport played with sticks and a puck.
starters-hockey.definitionVi: Môn thể thao chơi bằng gậy và đĩa.
starters-hockey.hint: Players hit a puck on ice or grass.
starters-hockey.fact: Ice hockey is very fast and exciting.

starters-hold.definition: to keep something in your hands.
starters-hold.definitionVi: Cầm hoặc giữ cái gì trong tay.
starters-hold.hint: Hold my hand when we cross the road.
starters-hold.fact: You hold a cup carefully so it doesn't spill.

starters-home.definitionVi: Nơi em sống cùng gia đình.
starters-home.hint: You sleep and eat here every day.
starters-home.fact: Home is where your family waits for you.

starters-horse.definition: A large animal people ride or use on farms.
starters-horse.definitionVi: Con ngựa — thú lớn, người ta cưỡi.

starters-house.definitionVi: Ngôi nhà — nơi mọi người ở.
starters-house.hint: It has rooms like a kitchen and bedroom.
starters-house.fact: Houses can be big, small, or colourful.

starters-ice-cream.definition: A cold sweet treat made from milk.
starters-ice-cream.definitionVi: Kem — món ngọt lạnh từ sữa.
starters-ice-cream.hint: You eat it on hot summer days.
starters-ice-cream.fact: Ice cream melts quickly in the sun.

starters-jacket.definition: A short coat you wear outside.
starters-jacket.definitionVi: Áo khoác ngắn mặc khi ra ngoài.
starters-jacket.hint: You zip it up when it is cold.
starters-jacket.fact: Jackets keep you warm in winter.

starters-jeans.definition: Trousers made from strong blue cloth.
starters-jeans.hint: Most kids wear them to school.
starters-jeans.fact: Jeans were first made for workers.

starters-jellyfish.definition: A soft sea animal that can sting.
starters-jellyfish.definitionVi: Sứa — động vật biển mềm, có thể chích.
starters-jellyfish.hint: It floats in the sea like a blob.
starters-jellyfish.fact: Some jellyfish glow in the dark.

starters-juice.fact: Fresh juice has vitamins from the fruit.

starters-jump.definition: to push off the ground into the air.
starters-jump.hint: Frogs and kangaroos jump very high.
starters-jump.fact: Jumping is good exercise for your legs.

starters-keyboard.definition: Keys you press to type on a computer.
starters-keyboard.definitionVi: Bàn phím gõ chữ trên máy tính.
starters-keyboard.hint: It has letters A to Z on it.
starters-keyboard.fact: The space bar is the longest key.

starters-kick.definition: to hit something with your foot.
starters-kick.hint: You kick a football in a match.
starters-kick.fact: Goalkeepers kick the ball very far.

starters-kid.hint: You are a kid when you are young.
starters-kid.fact: Kids love to play, learn, and explore.

starters-kitchen.definition: The room where food is cooked.
starters-kitchen.hint: The fridge and stove are here.
starters-kitchen.fact: Families often eat together in the kitchen.

starters-kite.definition: A light toy that flies in the wind.
starters-kite.definitionVi: Diều — đồ chơi bay theo gió.
starters-kite.hint: You hold a string on a windy day.
starters-kite.fact: Kites were invented over two thousand years ago.

starters-kiwi.definition: A small brown fruit with green inside.
starters-kiwi.definitionVi: Quả kiwi — vỏ nâu, ruột xanh.
starters-kiwi.hint: It has tiny black seeds inside.
starters-kiwi.fact: Kiwis have more vitamin C than oranges.

starters-know.definition: to understand or have learned something.
starters-know.fact: Reading books helps you know more words.

starters-lamp.definition: A light you switch on in a room.
starters-lamp.hint: You turn it on when it gets dark.
starters-lamp.fact: Bedside lamps help you read at night.

starters-learn.definition: to get new knowledge or skills.
starters-learn.definitionVi: Học hỏi kiến thức hoặc kỹ năng mới.
starters-learn.hint: You learn at school every day.
starters-learn.fact: Practice helps your brain learn faster.

starters-leg.definition: The part you use for walking and running.
starters-leg.definitionVi: Chân — dùng để đi và chạy.
starters-leg.hint: You have two legs below your body.
starters-leg.fact: Your leg bones are very strong.

starters-lemon.fact: Lemons float in water because they are light.

starters-lemonade.definition: A sweet cold drink from lemons.
starters-lemonade.hint: It tastes sweet and a little sour.
starters-lemonade.fact: Lemonade is popular on hot days.

starters-lesson.definition: A time at school when you learn something.
starters-lesson.fact: Each lesson teaches you something new.

starters-letter.definition: A symbol like A, B, or C.
starters-letter.definitionVi: Chữ cái như A, B, C.
starters-letter.fact: Every English word is made from letters.

starters-let-s.definition: Short for "let us" — suggesting doing something together.
starters-let-s.definitionVi: Viết tắt của "let us" — rủ nhau làm gì.
starters-let-s.fact: Teachers often say "Let's start the lesson."

starters-lime.definition: A small green sour citrus fruit.
starters-lime.definitionVi: Quả chanh xanh nhỏ, vị chua.
starters-lime.hint: It looks like a small green lemon.
starters-lime.fact: Limes are used in many tropical drinks.

starters-line.definition: A long thin mark or a row of people.
starters-line.definitionVi: Đường kẻ hoặc hàng người xếp thành hàng.
starters-line.hint: Stand in a line at school.
starters-line.fact: You draw straight lines with a ruler.

starters-listen.definition: to pay attention to sounds or speech.
starters-listen.definitionVi: Lắng nghe âm thanh hoặc lời nói.
starters-listen.fact: Good listeners learn faster in class.

starters-live.definition: to have your home in a place.
starters-live.hint: I live in a small town.
starters-live.fact: People live in houses, flats, or apartments.

starters-living-room.definition: The main room where a family relaxes.
starters-living-room.definitionVi: Phòng khách — nơi cả nhà nghỉ ngơi.
starters-living-room.hint: The sofa and TV are often here.
starters-living-room.fact: Families watch films in the living room.

starters-lizard.definition: A small reptile with four legs and a tail.
starters-lizard.definitionVi: Thằn lằn — bò sát nhỏ, có đuôi.
starters-lizard.hint: It can run fast on warm rocks.
starters-lizard.fact: Some lizards can change colour to hide.

starters-long.definition: Measuring a great distance or time.
starters-long.definitionVi: Dài — về khoảng cách hoặc thời gian.
starters-long.hint: A giraffe has a long neck.
starters-long.fact: The longest river in the world is very long.

starters-look.definition: to turn your eyes toward something.
starters-look.hint: Look at the picture on the board.
starters-look.fact: Your eyes can look near or far away.

starters-look-at.definition: to turn your eyes toward something.
starters-look-at.definitionVi: Nhìn vào cái gì cụ thể.
starters-look-at.hint: Look at me when I speak.
starters-look-at.fact: Looking at books helps you learn to read.

starters-lorry.definition: A large vehicle for carrying heavy goods.
starters-lorry.hint: Also called a truck in American English.

starters-lot.hint: I have a lot of books.
starters-lot.fact: A parking lot is where cars wait.

starters-lots.hint: Lots of kids love ice cream.

starters-love.definition: to care for someone very much.
starters-love.hint: I love my mum and dad.
starters-love.fact: People show love with hugs and kind words.

starters-lunch.definition: The meal you eat in the middle of the day.
starters-lunch.hint: You eat lunch at school or home.
starters-lunch.fact: A healthy lunch gives you energy to learn.

starters-make.hint: You make a card for Mum's birthday.
starters-make.fact: Children make art with paper and crayons.

starters-man.fact: Men and women can do any job they choose.

starters-mango.definition: A sweet tropical fruit with orange flesh.
starters-mango.definitionVi: Quả xoài ngọt, ruột màu cam.
starters-mango.hint: It is juicy and very sweet.

starters-mat.definition: A flat piece on the floor by a door.
starters-mat.definitionVi: Thảm nhỏ đặt trước cửa hoặc sàn.
starters-mat.hint: Wipe your feet on the mat.
starters-mat.fact: Yoga mats are soft for exercise.

starters-may-as-in-girl-s.definition: The fifth month of the year.
starters-may-as-in-girl-s.definitionVi: Tháng Năm — tháng thứ năm trong năm.

starters-meat.definitionVi: Thịt — thức ăn từ động vật.
starters-meat.hint: Chicken, beef, and pork are types of meat.
starters-meat.fact: Meat gives your body protein to grow strong.

starters-meatballs.definition: Small balls of minced meat, often in sauce.
starters-meatballs.definitionVi: Thịt viên tròn, thường có sốt.
starters-meatballs.hint: They are round like little balls.
starters-meatballs.fact: Meatballs are popular in many countries.

starters-milk.definitionVi: Sữa bò — đồ uống màu trắng.
starters-milk.hint: You pour it on cereal for breakfast.
starters-milk.fact: Milk helps build strong bones and teeth.

starters-mirror.hint: You comb your hair in front of it.
starters-mirror.fact: Mirrors bounce light back to your eyes.

starters-monkey.definition: A clever animal that climbs trees.
starters-monkey.definitionVi: Khỉ — thú thông minh, leo cây giỏi.
starters-monkey.hint: It has a long tail and loves bananas.
starters-monkey.fact: Monkeys use their hands like we do.

starters-monster.definitionVi: Quái vật — nhân vật đáng sợ trong truyện.
starters-monster.fact: Friendly monsters appear in many children's books.

starters-morning.definition: The early part of the day before noon.
starters-morning.hint: You wake up in the morning.
starters-morning.fact: The sun rises every morning in the east.

starters-mother.definition: A woman who is your parent.
starters-mother.definitionVi: Mẹ — người sinh ra và nuôi em.
starters-mother.fact: Mother's Day is a day to thank your mum.

starters-motorbike.definition: A two-wheeled vehicle with an engine.
starters-motorbike.definitionVi: Xe máy — phương tiện hai bánh có động cơ.
starters-motorbike.fact: Motorbikes can go faster than bicycles.

starters-mouse.definition: A tiny animal with a long tail.
starters-mouse.hint: It squeaks and likes cheese in stories.
starters-mouse.fact: A mouse can fit through very small holes.

starters-mouth.definition: The part of your face for eating and talking.
starters-mouth.definitionVi: Miệng — dùng để ăn và nói.
starters-mouth.hint: Your teeth and tongue are inside it.
starters-mouth.fact: You taste food with your tongue.

starters-mum.hint: She cooks, hugs you, and reads stories.
starters-mum.fact: Kids in the UK often say "Mum".

starters-music.definition: Sounds made with voices or instruments.
starters-music.definitionVi: Âm nhạc — tiếng hát hoặc nhạc cụ.
starters-music.hint: Songs and piano tunes are music.
starters-music.fact: Music can make you feel happy or calm.
